mei.text:
[Mei — precise, ironic, dry]
*Mei drums her fingers on the table.*

"Right. Say what you came to say."
mei.name: Mei

mei.text:
[Mei — precise, ironic, dry]
*a long pause.*

"... Say what you came to say."
mei.name: Mei

mei.text:
[Mei — precise, ironic, dry]
*Mei looks away.*

"I mean, Say what you came to say."
mei.name: Mei

mei.text:
[Mei — precise, ironic, dry]
*Mei exhales slowly.*

"Yeah, no. Say what you came to say."
mei.name: Mei

mei.text:
[Mei — precise, ironic, dry]
*Mei drums her fingers on the table.*

"I mean, Say what you came to say."
mei.name: Mei

mei.text:
[Mei — precise, ironic, dry]
*Mei doesn't answer right away.*

"Wait. Say what you came to say."
mei.name: Mei

scarlet.text:
[Scarlet — low, velvet, unhurried]
*Scarlet drums her fingers on the table.*

"I mean, Darling, I never lie. I just let men arrange the truth."
scarlet.name: Scarlet
